antecedent.freeze_modification_policy: Any scientific-package modification requires a new version; frozen artifacts are not edited in place.

trigger.finding: The frozen v001 fixture records a P1/P2 presentation label, but does not explicitly materialize the frozen P1/P2 representation semantics as presentation data.

design_requirement.P1: action-keyed tabular records, one row per action, with the same neutral descriptor fields for every action
design_requirement.P2: action-keyed ordered records using the same fields and values but a different presentation order determined by a frozen permutation

trigger.reason: A presentation label alone does not make the intended representation/order independently reconstructable from the fixture.

correction.scope: Add an explicit, reconstructable P1/P2 representation to each decision instance.

P1.records: one record per current action, containing the frozen neutral descriptor fields and the action key

P2.records: the same action records, with an explicit frozen presentation order
P2.order: must be explicitly stored and reconstructable; it must use the same fields and values as P1

current state S0 and current T_acc={a,b,c}
all fixture-level values not required by the explicit P1/P2 representation correction
prohibited_changes: do not edit v001 in place
do not alter the experimental design
do not alter Q1-Q6 scope or estimands
do not alter condition or presentation allocation

identity_consequence.expected_effect: The v002 fixture SHA/package identity must differ from v001.
